model_interpretation.claim: A dynamic pixel schedule with chunks of 64 should balance spatially varying hit and ambient-occlusion work better than a static contiguous partition while keeping scheduling overhead bounded. Per-pixel SplitMix64 streams seeded from one serial draw should make samples independent of worker scheduling and thread count; the one-worker path avoids OpenMP overhead.

model_interpretation.claim: The paired-sine/cosine variant measured 3.493764 s versus the 3.496109 s baseline, while the selected parent’s ambient-origin precomputation measured 3.348743 s; these aggregate results do not establish which ambient cost dominates. This separate experiment keeps the parent’s precomputation and sampling math but stores all 64 generated directions in structure-of-arrays form, then processes each sphere across independent ray lanes. The loops may expose intersection arithmetic to compiler auto-vectorization without ISA-specific code; whether that happens and whether it helps remain to be measured.
